description: The Broad Rental Market Area of every 2021 LSOA in England and Wales and every 2022 output area in Scotland, by population-weighted centroid in the published BRMA polygons (Scotland corrected by Rent Service Scotland's postcode lookup). Read by the post-geography node uk.full.geography.brma (microcosm#1262); rebuilt by tools/build_uk_brma_area_layer.py.
